bagPolicy.summary: Bags and purses no larger than 12 × 6 × 12 inches are allowed and do not have to be clear. Larger medical equipment bags and parenting bags accompanying a child are inspected; backpacks or oversize bags cannot be stored at Guest Services.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Surface-lot parking via Taborwood Avenue costs $20 in advance or $25 on the event day, subject to space. Accessible parking is east of the plaza.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Designated rideshare pickup and drop-off are directly in front of the ticket office.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are available on the first-floor lobby and third-floor loge and club levels. The venue is cashless and does not admit outside food and drinks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is east of the plaza, with an accessible drop-off area southwest of the building. Listening devices are at Guest Services and the venue asks for 14 days of notice for an ASL interpreter.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry after leaving the venue.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue lists Friday box-office hours of 10 a.m.–4 p.m., but its published venue guide does not state a concert will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors open about one hour before most events. Guests and their belongings are screened at entry; guests without bags may use the no-bag line.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
